estimates.t: The Company recognizes revenue in accordance with ASC Topic 606, ‘Revenue from Contracts with Customers,’ and applies ASC 340, ‘Other Assets and Deferred Costs,’ for the recognition and measurement of contract costs.

estimates.name: RESULTS OF OPERATION
estimates.t: Our financial statements have been prepared assuming that we will continue as a going concern.

estimates.name: Year Ended July 31, 2026 compared to year Ended July 31, 2025 — Revenue
estimates.t: During the year ended July 31, 2026, the Company had $52,000 in revenue compared to $94,500 during the year ended July 31, 2025.

estimates.name: Cost of revenue
estimates.t: During the year ended July 31, 2026, the Company had $30,000 in cost of revenue compared to $70,000 during the year ended July 31, 2025.

estimates.name: Operating Expenses
estimates.t: During the year ended July 31, 2026, we incurred total operating expenses of $81,440 compared to $64,289 during the year ended July 31, 2025.

estimates.name: Net Loss
estimates.t: Our net loss for the year ended July 31, 2026 was $59,440 compared to $43,690 during the year ended July 31, 2025.
